name: io.github.firedrill-tools/firedrill
title: Firedrill
description: Operate simulations and inspect retained evidence with Firedrill.

environmentVariables.name: FIREDRILL_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Exact approved Firedrill API origin; required, no inferred default.

environmentVariables.name: FIREDRILL_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional scoped CI credential from the caller's secret store; otherwise use protected operator login.

environmentVariables.name: FIREDRILL_MCP_READONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set true to expose only read tools.
